title: catalyst backlog
description: What `catalyst backlog --json` prints and `GET /v1/backlog` returns: open work (any status outside its type's closed states) by type and status, open items missing a required link, and the rules no open item targets.

open.description: Type prefix → status → the IDs of the open items in it.

missing_links.description: An open item and the required reference field it leaves empty.

coverage.description: The project's active rules (the handbook's meta-rules left out), and those at least one artifact (open or closed) cites in a reference field (catalyst >= 0.78.0).
